---
title: "Glossary"
---

| Term | Plain-language meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **ADK** | Google Agent Development Kit, a toolkit for building AI assistants. |
| **Agent** | A software program that can reason about inputs and trigger actions (like calling APIs). |
| **CLI** | Command-line interface; you interact with ADK by typing commands. |
| **Gemini** | Google’s family of AI models used by ADK. |
| **API key** | A secret string that identifies you to Google’s services. |
| **Python** | The programming language ADK runs on. |
| **Python 3.11** | The specific Python release targeted in this guide. |
| **Virtual environment (`venv`)** | A folder that contains its own Python interpreter and packages. |
| **`pip`** | Python’s standard package manager for installing libraries. |
| **PATH** | An environment variable that tells your computer where to look for programs. |
| **PowerShell** | The default command-line shell included with Windows 10/11. |
| **Terminal** | The macOS application used to run shell commands. |
